sloka: क्षिप्रम् वज्रसमैर्बाणैः शतधा कार्मुकचुतैः ।राममादीपयिष्यामि उल्कभिरिव कुञ्जरम् ॥६-१३-१९॥।।
transliteration: kṣipram vajrasamairbāṇaiḥ śatadhā kārmukacutaiḥ ।rāmamādīpayiṣyāmi ulkabhiriva kuñjaram ॥6-13-19॥।।

translations.english: At once with thunderbolts and meteor like arrows released from my bow will blaze up Rama just like fire sticks whirled at elephants.
